autoReplyPolling.note: trigger: "idle" (new, default) — driven by idleDaemon + systemd; "cron" (legacy) — system crontab runs auto-check.sh every N minutes. lastCheckedAt still tracks the last check so each run only fetches new messages (also used by the daemon's offline catch-up).

idleDaemon.note: IMAP IDLE event-trigger daemon (scripts/email-mcp-server/idle-daemon.js). Holds a persistent IMAP IDLE connection; on new mail (exists event) it batches arrivals within debounceSeconds then runs scripts/auto-check.sh. Managed on Linux as systemd service 'crm-idle-daemon' (deploy/crm-idle-daemon.service, scripts/install-idle-daemon.sh).

note_language: "en" for English (default), "zh" for Chinese. Controls email language and Skill UI prompts.
note_autoApprove: Set to true to skip draft review and send emails immediately. When combined with autoReplyPolling (bash+cron), the full pipeline runs hands-free 24/7.
note_teamMembers: Configure your team members here. They appear as handoff targets when transferring a prospect to a human.

workingHours.note: Working hours in prospect's local time (24h format). Outreach emails are only sent during this window. Reply emails ignore this restriction.

note_timezone: Default timezone when TLD lookup fails. TLD mapping: .cn→Asia/Shanghai, .jp→Asia/Tokyo, .kr→Asia/Seoul, .de→Europe/Berlin, .fr→Europe/Paris, .uk→Europe/London, .au→Australia/Sydney, .in→Asia/Kolkata, .br→America/Sao_Paulo, .us→America/New_York, .ca→America/Toronto

im.note: IM integration via cc-connect. Set enabled:false to disable all IM push notifications.
im.note_platforms: Active IM platforms. Push notifications are sent to ALL active platforms via cc-connect.

notifications.note_interestedIntent: Push when a prospect is classified as INTERESTED (Phase 5)
notifications.note_coldInbound: Push when a new cold inbound lead is detected (Phase 4 Tier 3)
notifications.note_autoReplySent: Push when auto-reply is sent and contact is handed over (Phase 6)
notifications.note_systemError: Push when SMTP/IMAP or other system errors occur
notifications.note_emailSent: Push when outreach email is sent (Phase 3) — noisy, off by default
notifications.note_notInterested: Push when prospect is classified NOT_INTERESTED (Phase 5) — noisy, off by default

inbound.note: IM inbound card processing. Set to true to allow sending business card images via Feishu/WeCom. When enabled, approval flows move to IM (reply-based) instead of terminal.
inbound.note_approvalMode: 'reply' means user replies '批准'/'拒绝' to approve/reject drafts via WeCom. Future: 'card' for interactive card buttons.
inbound.note_approvalTimeout: If no approval reply within this time, the draft expires.

allow_from.note: Per-platform user whitelists. Feishu has HMAC signature — allow_from is optional but recommended. WeCom has no HMAC signature — allow_from is CRITICAL.
